title: Love Song
lyrics: Verse 1:
[Em]I've heard it said that a [C]man would climb a mountain
[D]Just to be with the [G]one he [B7]loves.
[Em]How many times has he [C]broken that promise -
[D]It has never been [G]done.
Pre-Chorus 1:
I've never [C]climbed the highest [G]mountain,
but I [C]walked the hill of Calva[D]ry...
Chorus 1:
Just to [G]be with you, I would do [D]anything;
There's no [C]price I would not [G]pay.[D]
Just to [G]be with you, I would give [D]everything;
I would [C]give my life [Em]away.[D]
Verse 2:
I've heard it said that a man would swim the ocean
Just to be with the one he loves.
Well all those dreams are an empty emotion -
It can never be done.
Pre-Chorus 2:
I never swam the deepest oceans,
but I walked upon the raging sea...
Bridge 1:
And I [Bm]know that you don't understand the [Em]fullness of my love,
How I [C]died upon the cross for your [G]sins.
And I [Bm]know that you don't realize how [Em]much I gave you,
And I [C]promise I would do it all a[D]gain.
Chorus 2:
Just to be with you, I've done everything;
Theres no price I did not pay.
Just to be with you, I gave everything;
Yes, I gave my life away.
I gave my life away.
artist: Mac Powell, Brad Avery, David Carr, Mark Lee, Tai Anderson
